04 / PERSONAL MEANS PERSONAL

Your library.
On your terms.

No Luma account to create. Your connection goes directly to your provider. On Mac, login details stay in Keychain. On Android TV, credentials and watch state are encrypted with a device Keystore key.

Favorites and progress are stored per source on each device. There is no cloud sync between Mac and Android TV.

Ready in a few steps.

  1. Install Luma.On Mac, unzip and move Luma to Applications. For this unnotarized build, approve it in Privacy & Security if macOS blocks the first launch. On TV, transfer the APK and allow installation for the file manager you use.
  2. Bring your library.Enter your Xtream-compatible provider details or an M3U URL. Local M3U files work where a file picker is available.
  3. Make it yours.Pick favorite titles, customize Discover, and settle in. Use only content you have permission to access.
A FEW THINGS TO KNOW

Before you
settle in.

Does Luma include channels or a subscription?

No. Luma is a player. You supply your own authorized Xtream-compatible provider account or M3U playlist. It does not sell or bundle content.

Can I use it on my Mi Box?

The Android build is designed for TV remotes and supports Android 6.0 or later, without restricting the APK to one CPU architecture. It has been checked on an Android TV emulator. Playback on your specific Mi Box still needs to be verified; available codecs, firmware and stream formats affect compatibility.

Will my progress sync between screens?

No. Each device keeps its own favorites, history, Discover layout and resume positions, scoped to your connected source.

Which stream formats are supported?

Android TV uses Media3 for supported HLS, DASH and progressive streams, subject to the device’s codecs. The Mac app can use an installed VLC runtime or fall back to AVPlayer. Your provider determines stream availability and quality.

How do I update the Android app?

Install a newer signed APK over the current installation. Updates must use the same signing key. Keep your installed app in place to preserve its local watch state.

Are these store releases?

These are direct builds for manual installation. The Mac build is locally signed and has not been notarized by Apple. The Android APK is signed for sideloading and has not been published on Google Play.
